object.name: InlineQueryResultDocument
object.description: Represents a link to a file. By default, this file will be sent by the user with an optional caption. Alternatively, you can use input_message_content to send a message with the specified content instead of the file. Currently, only .PDF and .ZIP files can be sent using this method.
object.html_description: Represents a link to a file. By default, this file will be sent by the user with an optional caption. Alternatively, you can use input_message_content to send a message with the specified content instead of the file. Currently, only .PDF and .ZIP files can be sent using this method.
object.rst_description: Represents a link to a file. By default, this file will be sent by the user with an optional caption. Alternatively, you can use *input_message_content* to send a message with the specified content instead of the file. Currently, only **.PDF** and **.ZIP** files can be sent using this method.

annotations.name: type
annotations.description: Type of the result, must be document
annotations.rst_description: Type of the result, must be *document*

annotations.name: id
annotations.description: Unique identifier for this result, 1-64 bytes
annotations.rst_description: Unique identifier for this result, 1-64 bytes

annotations.name: caption
annotations.description: Optional. Caption of the document to be sent, 0-1024 characters after entities parsing
annotations.html_description: Optional. Caption of the document to be sent, 0-1024 characters after entities parsing
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Caption of the document to be sent, 0-1024 characters after entities parsing

annotations.html_description: Optional. Mode for parsing entities in the document caption. See formatting options for more details.
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Mode for parsing entities in the document caption. See `formatting options <https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#formatting-options>`_ for more details.

annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. List of special entities that appear in the caption, which can be specified instead of *parse_mode*
